new.EN:
This castle is known as the Nevernight Castle.
They say wild revelries take place in the castle's spires night after night.
I'd love to be invited to one of Lord Wynan's banquets someday!
The Lady Mother is... well, an artist with a very eccentric sense of style.
Is it just me? I feel like the statues and paintings are watching me.
What a magnificent collection of art!
How many years has it been since anyone last saw Lord Wynan and the Lady Mother?
This ancient castle is counted among the Ten Scenic Wonders of Tyris.
Gareth is a truly rotten bastard.
Gareth is a complete asshole. It's scum like him that makes the world such a messed-up place.
The sweet scent of roses fills the air wherever you go!
That statue looks exactly like someone I know.

...Honestly, how many times must you rehash the same argument before you are satisfied?

I am plotting nothing. The dragon child and the witch girl are safe.

I made a promise to my master. If words held no power, and an oath meant no more than the howl of a beast, I would have killed those two and taken the Magic Stone long ago.

I care naught for thine oath.

Whether a befouled creature such as thee keeps its word can be known only once the word is broken.
...My, what a baseless accusation.

Heh heh heh... "Baseless," thou sayest? How amusing to hear such a word from thy lips.

Surely thou hast not forgotten? The pact thou hast yet to fulfill—thy pact with me.

...Heh. That again, is it? I recall making no pact. I merely lent you a hand because you were so very pitiable.

A pity about the girl. She will never come back. Though I must say, for my part, it was a truly fascinating thing to witness...
...Fascinating, thou sayest?
Thou wouldst call "that" fascinating? Thou... thou didst... my daughter... my Telessia!

...N-now, now, now!

Calm down, both of you. There's no need to raise your voices right in the middle of the base, is there?

That man is right. One should not raise one's voice in public.

...Wouldn't you agree, Inquisitor?
...Do not call me by that name.
Then what shall I call you? Exile? Or perhaps...
Silence, boy!
(...If these two start fighting in earnest, the whole base will be reduced to rubble.)
Now, now, I'm sure you both have plenty to say, but... Hm? ...That redhead coming this way...
Huff... huff... Loytel!

Ah, Quruitzia, just in time!

You're all out of breath. What on earth is the matter?
I was picking herbs on the hill, like always, and a man was lying there, hurt all over... Farris said to go get help.

A wounded man, you say? That sounds like trouble. All right, #pc, let's go to Lady Farris.

Uh... and Quruitzia. Stay here and keep an eye on these two so they don't start fighting.
...Fighting?
...Hmph.

...What a terrible state. Wounds all over. Judging by the attire, some sort of knight?

Let's see... Still a little conscious, it seems. Here, take my shoulder!
Ugh... Do not touch me...
Heavier than you'd think to look at... Lady Farris, take the other shoulder, would you?
Of course.
Stop... Do not touch me... human...
Oh my, delirious... Your head is bleeding. Here, hold on to me.
...I said... do not lay your hands on me so freely... you bitch!
Uh...
Ahem... Um... Lady Farris...
...Yes, Lord Loytel?

Rest assured, being called a bitch does not bother me in the least. This gentleman must have struck his head badly, and is simply talking in delirium.

Now, let us carry him quickly.
...Wait, I told you not to touch me! A mere human, daring to lay hands on me—
(The sound of a harp striking a head)

There, he is quiet now. Thrashing about would only aggravate his wounds.

Let us carry him to a bed while we can, Lord Loytel.
...R-right.
This man... between the attire and the features, clearly not from around here... Good grief, I hope this doesn't turn into another mess.
Ugh... ngh...
Oh, you're awake.
Where... am I...
#pc's base. Well, I'm the one actually running things here, mind you.
We found you collapsed on the hill and brought you here. You were covered in wounds, and it looked like you'd taken a hard blow to the head. How are you feeling?
...My head...
...Strange. My head throbs far worse than any wound on my body.
That's, er... You must have hit it in just the wrong spot.
...So I was rescued. By humans, of all things.
Then this is a village of men... And yet, for that...
You keep going on about "humans" this and that. Are you sure you're not still in a daze?
...Ah, yes, I had forgotten. Your kind can only measure things by what meets the eye.
...I am a dragon.

Close that gaping mouth.

I shall overlook your rudeness. No dragon demands courtesy of a wild dog.
Wait, wait. However you look at it, you're plainly a...
Are you ignorant as well as rude? Dragons possess immense magical power. Taking human form is a trifling matter.
...Still, something has been nagging at me. There are several extraordinary presences in this village.
...I see. So this is the place!
...The place for what?
The village where the Steel Dragon dwells. The Steel Dragon of Vernis has taken up residence in a human village and keeps the humans in his service. I followed that rumor all the way here.
The Steel Dragon of Vernis... You mean Corgon?

I knew it!

I shall say nothing of your calling your lord by his bare name. Servant, announce me to Lord Steel Dragon at once.
Why are you standing there gaping? I mean you.
(Takes a deep breath)
...Now listen well. I am the illustrious frontier inspector dispatched from Mysilia. Or rather, I was—in any case, I have now been entrusted with this base, and—
Ah, the head servant. All the better, then.
...I have a headache.
...So, who are you, then? And what business could you possibly have with our "Lord Steel Dragon"?
...My name is Vesda. Vesda, the Fire Dragon.

Head servant, convey this to your master: the dragon who rules the dragon caverns of the west has come with a request for Lord Steel Dragon—an urgent matter on which the survival of my clan depends. And this is a peril that concerns you as well.
Whether you get announced is for me to decide. Let's hear it. What exactly is this peril?
A dragon hunt...

new.EN: Adventurer's Weekly No. 26: Delegated Farming,Yowyn Correspondent Celia,10,1
Hi! Welcome to Adventurer's Weekly, where we cover topics near and dear to your brave hearts. Today, I'm introducing a helpful service from the Church of Kumiromi: delegated farming!

Adventurers regularly leave home for weeks or months, and often don't have time to tend to their crops! Happily, the Church offers basic care for your fields, setting your heart at ease while you're away!
Getting Started

As it happens, I'm slated to head down to Olvina and pick up a new strain of grape seeds for my garden! However, the trip could take half a month, and by the time I return all my precious veggies will have withered! I don't have anyone around to help, so the harvest — and more importantly, my seed strains — will be lost!
Oh no! What do I do?
Thankfully, my hearth stone's level two, so I'm eligible to request help from the Church — all I have to do is activate the ordnance from my home board, and they'll dispatch volunteers to my rescue!
Setting Up

Before I leave, I need to ensure good working conditions for the church's helpers: farm signs to indicate which crops need minding, and proper shared storages to ensure the harvest is correctly stored. It's not just fruits and veggies — even by-products like sticks and straw need a place to go, and if there isn't one the volunteers will just place them in the shipping bin! Good if you want to sell them, bad if you want to cook with your veggies later!

While I'm away, the harvest will be brought in just before it withers — usually five days after ripening! What they won't do is water, not with so many adventurers needing their services, so I guess I'll just have to hope for rain! Or maybe not, since I'll be on the road…
Let's hope I didn't make any mistakes and they do their job right!
Harvest

Two weeks have passed, and now I'm back! Let's see… yep, the church volunteers have been through my gardens and harvested everything I marked with a farm sign! They've also not just replanted my veggies, but also improved the seeds — not as much as if I'd done it myself, but it's something!

Looking into the shared fridge and box, both my veggies and their by-products are neatly put away — minus went into replanting and payment for their work, of course! After everything, I'm left with about a third of the yield I would've had were I at home, compared to nothing at all and losing my veggie strains!
All in all, I'd say using delegated farming was a great success!
Tips and Tricks
* Delegated farming begins work at 6 am!
* If your plants leave remnants, you can bring in the harvest yourself and ask delegated farming to just replant your fields from the leftovers. Convenient if you don't want to bother with sickles!
* Different seed strains of the same crop in adjacent plots will be homogenized. Separate your delicate and crispy turnips if you want to keep them distinct!
* Seeds are improved from west to east, south to north. If you swap the north-easternmost seed with the south-westernmost, your crop quality might improve faster…

Thanks to tireless work from the Church of Kumiromi, adventurers can explore North Tyris without worrying about their crops at home! Even if you don't worship him, delegated farming's worth being grateful for, isn't it?
Thank you for reading, and we'll see you in next week's issue!

Adventurer's Weekly No. 27: Taxes,Grandma Shu,10,1
Welcome to Adventurer's Weekly, where I answer you youngins' questions on money.

This week's letter is by a recent arrival from Zanan: <color=blue>"Grandma Shu, this is my first month in Olvina and I'm already being taxed! How is this fair, I don't have an oren to my name!"</color>
Okay, youngin'. First thing you do is take a deep breath and calm yerself.
Second thing you do is realize taxes ain't so bad.

Yes, I get it. Grandma Shu was once like you, grumblin' about paying my hard-earned orens to some royal I'd never see. But when you oughta realize is your first couple tax bills as an adventurer are about getting you to go out and do things — can't have a bunch of "adventurers" loafin' around, gettin' up to mischief. Without taxes, many youngins wouldn't have that push to explore the world and find ways to make money.
Your first couple bills should be easily covered by foragin' a few flowers, doing a few odd jobs in town. But this issue ain't about gettin' the money to pay yer taxes, it's about understandin' them.
Tax Structure
Forget property and income taxes — as an adventurer, you might find a fortune in a nefia one month an' go hungry the next. Hence, you're taxed as such under Mysilia's jurisdiction:
*A base value. This starts at 500 orens and increases by 500 annually, up to a total of 5,500 orens after 10 years.
*A fame value. This is 2 orens to 1 fame under 5000: advanced adventurers' bills still grow past that, but at a reduced rate.

*Voluntary tax. If you wanna get in good with Mysilia, you can sign up for these at a maid; get your landlord to appoint one if there ain't any. These go up to 20,000 every month, and you'll get a gold bar for every 1,000 orens you pay.

Your tax bill is all these added up; if you have trouble figurin' it out, you can always check the tax breakdown at yer home board. The biggest monthly bill them bastards can send you is 1,000,000 orens — as much as they'd like to, they can't milk you for more. I'm not sure why, and I honestly find that more disturbin'.
Tax Evasion

Unwilling to pay, are ya? Well, there's always Derphy. I don't do business there ever since fallin' out with Mistress Persephone, but hey, if you're as free-spirited as that lady you can be a criminal like her, too.

But if you oren-pinchin' youngins don't wanna run afoul of the law, ya can do public service instead. Fall behind on 3 bills an' each one after that'll cost you 40 karma. You just have to make that up every month, appease the taxman with sweat instead of coin. Clear out nefia and make the land safer, help out folks with their requests, that kinda thing. Your tax bills won't be overlooked, but at least you won't be a criminal.

Or if you don't mind payin' in another coin, I know a couple hillfolk out east who could help ya find "lost" bills for some small medals. Note that "paying" your taxes this way won't earn you gold bars if you signed up for voluntary tax — ya gotta pay the original bill for that.
There's always trying to fool tax assessors, but I think it's a waste of gold bars. Should you get really famous adventurin', youngin, taxes aren't really a problem.
Automatic Taxation

Most youngins know ya can ticket a tax box an' take it home. But if yer really lazy, there's always the salary transfer an' transfer tax payment policies. Once ya sign up for these at yer home board, yer bank account will handle both yer salary an' taxes; so long as the first exceeds the second, you'll never have to worry 'bout losing bills or missing payments ever again.
<i>As they say in Yerl: the only certain things in life are death and taxes. Both seem scary, but if you youngins take them in stride you'll soon realize there's no need to get upset about either.
Write me again anytime, youngins, and look forward to the next issue!

First things first, ya gotta have land. Find an attractive spot; my own store's on a snowfield with an ancient ruin. Ain't much you have to build — you can just sell things outta a wagon — but some folks like a nice storefront. What you do need is a sales tag: make one at a signboard workshop.

What you do with the tag, youngin', is slap it on yer wares. Open up for business, and people will come in to buy; if you've got a box near a stockpile sign with more of the same stuff, wares get restocked automatically. Taggin' a filled box marks everythin' in it for sale, good if yer the lazy sort like my granddaughter.

old.EN: So about yer question, youngin': running yer own shop. It's some work — you gotta set up a storefront, pass a few policies, keep wares in stock. But you'll be callin' the shots, settin' yer prices, and the only limit on yer sales is how many suckers you can hoodwink. Ain't somethin' that everyone cares for, but if you like the idea, Grandma Shu has some advice for you.
old.PTBR: Então, sobre a sua pergunta, novato: abrir a própria loja. Dá trabalho: você monta uma vitrine, passa umas políticas, mantém estoque. Mas quem manda é você: define os preços, e o único limite nas vendas é quantos otários consegue convencer. Não é pra todo mundo, mas se curtiu a ideia, a Vovó Shu tem uns conselhos.

old.EN: First things first, ya gotta have land. Find an attractive spot; my own store's on a snowfield with an ancient ruin. Ain't much you have to build — you can just sell things outta a wagon — but some folks like a nice storefront. What you do need is a sales tag: make one at a signboard workshop.
old.PTBR: Primeiro de tudo, você precisa de terra. Ache um ponto atraente; a minha loja fica num campo nevado com uma ruína antiga. Não é preciso construir muito: dá para vender de uma carroça mesmo, mas tem gente que gosta de uma vitrine bonita. O que você precisa é de uma etiqueta de venda: faça uma numa oficina de placas.

old.EN: What you do with the tag, youngin', is slap it on yer wares. Open up for business, and people will come in to buy; if you've got a box near a stockpile sign with more of the same stuff, wares get restocked automatically. Taggin' a filled box marks everythin' in it for sale, good if yer the lazy sort like my granddaughter.
old.PTBR: O que você faz com a etiqueta, novato, é grudar nas mercadorias. Abra as portas e o povo entra para comprar; se você tiver uma caixa perto de uma placa de estoque com mais do mesmo, o estoque repõe sozinho. Etiquetar uma caixa cheia põe tudo dentro à venda, bom se você for do tipo preguiçoso como minha neta.

old.EN: Making Money
old.PTBR: Fazendo Dinheiro

old.EN: But it don't stop there. You've got a shop, now yer job's to draw in all them customers and wring every miserable oren outta their pockets. That means, youngin', you've got to attack from different angles.
old.PTBR: Mas não para por aí. Você tem a loja, agora o trabalho é atrair todos os clientes e espremer cada oren mísero dos bolsos deles. Isso significa, novato, atacar de vários ângulos.

old.EN: Prices: put up some policies to increase your wares' value, stuff like a general store or restaurant license. Don't like rip-off store myself, feels short-sighted to me.
old.PTBR: Preços: ative políticas que aumentam o valor das mercadorias, coisas como licença de armazém geral ou restaurante. Loja de assalto não é comigo: acho míopia.

old.EN: Wealth: this here's vital, youngin'. Customers only buy what they can afford; if everythin' on sale's too expensive, nothing gets sold. You want rich folks coming into yer shop, so celebrity's heaven will draw them in. Wealthy folk like tourin' dangerous places, so put yer place off the beaten path.
old.PTBR: Riqueza: isto aqui é vital, novato. Clientes só compram o que podem pagar; se tudo à venda for caro demais, nada se vende. Você quer gente rica entrando na sua loja, então o paraíso das celebridades os atrai. Gente rica gosta de touredar lugares perigosos, então coloque a loja fora da rota batida.

old.EN: That's all the advice Grandma Shu has for you, simple enough that even my cow-shaped granddaughter can understand.
old.PTBR: Esses são todos os conselhos que a Vovó Shu tem, simples o bastante até para a minha neta com cara de vaca entender.

old.EN: [Fixes]
old.PTBR: [Correções]

old.EN: * Fixed an issue where friendly NPCs would become hostile if their area attacks or similar effects hit the PC.
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um problema em que NPCs amistosos ficavam hostis se os ataques de área deles ou efeitos similares atingissem o PC.

old.EN: * Fixed an issue where guests assigned beds were not sleeping in them when visiting a Home.
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um problema em que hóspedes com camas atribuídas não dormiam nelas ao visitar um Lar.

old.EN: * Fixed an issue where a festival tent could reappear if you entered a quest instance after collecting the tent during the festival and returned after the festival had ended.
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um problema em que a barraca de festival podia reaparecer se você entrasse numa instância de missão após recolher a barraca durante o festival e voltasse depois que o festival tivesse acabado.

old.EN: * Fixed an error that could occur when making an onsen egg in a range while fatigued, dying from overwork at the same time the egg exploded.
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um erro que podia ocorrer ao fazer um ovo de onsen no fogão enquanto exausto, morrendo de excesso de trabalho no mesmo momento em que o ovo explodia.

old.EN: * Fixed an issue where the ability "Fuse" fused one extra character. The correct number is 8 characters per fusion.
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um problema em que a habilidade "Fundir" fundia um personagem a mais. O número correto é 8 personagens por fusão.

old.EN: * Fixed an issue where highlights for furniture and other objects occupying multiple tiles could sometimes be displayed incorrectly.
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um problema em que os destaques de móveis e outros objetos que ocupam múltiplos pisos podiam às vezes ser exibidos incorretamente.

old.EN: * Fixed an issue where livestock could take food from Home containers even when the Home policy "Livestock Privileges" was not enabled.
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um problema em que o gado podia tomar comida dos contêineres do Lar mesmo sem a política do Lar "Privilégios do Gado" ativada.

old.EN: * Fixed the display order of the "Smoking" status, which had been grouped together with buffs.
old.PTBR: * Corrigida a ordem de exibição do estado "Fumando", que estava agrupado com as bênçãos.

old.EN: * Fixed an issue where adventurers who died in a town could immediately revive in the same town.
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um problema em que aventureiros mortos numa cidade podiam reviver imediatamente na mesma cidade.

old.EN: * Fixed an issue where abilities already learned through genes or similar means could not be used with the ranged attack shortcut key.
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um problema em que habilidades já aprendidas por genes ou meios similares não podiam ser usadas pela tecla de atalho de ataque à distância.

old.EN: * Fixed an error that occurred when middle-clicking taxidermy or cards with no contents assigned, such as those obtained through wishes.
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um erro que ocorria ao clicar com o botão do meio em empalhados ou cartas sem conteúdo atribuído, como os obtidos por desejos.

old.EN: * Added a new equipment slot, "Relic," and the relic "★Embryolith." After progressing through the Home story, the Relic slot can be unlocked by speaking to a certain NPC.
old.PTBR: * Adicionado um novo slot de equipamento, "Relíquia", e a relíquia "★Embriólito". Após progredir na história do Lar, o slot de Relíquia pode ser destravado falando com certo NPC.

old.EN: * Fixed an error that occurred when using the spell "Telekinesis" while Telekinesis Power was 0.
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um erro que ocorria ao usar o feitiço "Telecinesia" com Poder de Telecinesia 0.

old.EN: * Fixed an issue where the material of an item being copied with the Build Mode picker would sometimes not be reflected in the copied item.
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um problema em que o material de um item copiado com o conta-gotas do Modo Construção às vezes não aparecia no item copiado.

old.EN: * Fixed an issue where highlights for large furniture such as fountains could remain visible in Build Mode. Also fixed an issue where large furniture placed indoors could be visible from outside.
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um problema em que os destaques de móveis grandes como fontes podiam permanecer visíveis no Modo Construção. Também corrigido um problema em que móveis grandes colocados em ambientes internos podiam ser vistos de fora.

old.EN: * Fixed an error that occurred when using the Resident Board after Loytel moved during the quest "Gold Beneath."
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um erro que ocorria ao usar o Quadro de Moradores depois que o Loytel se movia durante a missão "Ouro Nas Entranhas".

old.EN: * Fixed an issue where character portrait contrast could sometimes become incorrect during conversations.
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um problema em que o contraste dos retratos podia às vezes ficar incorreto durante conversas.

old.EN: * Fixed an issue where the order of songs could no longer be changed using the up/down buttons while editing a playlist on the "Gramophone."
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um problema em que a ordem das músicas não podia mais ser mudada com os botões subir/descer ao editar uma playlist no "Gramofone".

old.EN: * Fixed an issue where the "Too Many Companions" warning could sometimes fail to appear when the party exceeded its member limit while a companion with the "Deviant" feat was present.
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um problema em que o aviso "Companheiros Demais" às vezes não aparecia quando o grupo ultrapassava o limite com um companheiro de dote "Desviante" presente.

old.EN: * Fixed an issue where the same material could sometimes appear more than once in the material selection list while crafting.
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um problema em que o mesmo material podia às vezes aparecer mais de uma vez na lista de seleção de materiais ao fabricar.

old.EN: * Fixed a rare error that could occur during pathfinding.
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um erro raro que podia ocorrer ao calcular caminhos.

old.EN: * Fixed an issue where reviving a pet at the Wedding Hall caused it to join the party.
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um problema em que reviver um bicho no Salão de Casamentos o fazia entrar no grupo.

old.EN: * Fixed an overflow issue when applying debuffs.
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um estouro de valor ao aplicar debuffs.

old.EN: * Fixed an error that could sometimes occur when residents revived during sleep.
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um erro que podia às vezes ocorrer quando moradores reviviam durante o sono.

old.EN: * Fixed incorrect Z values for items placed on round-table-type furniture.
old.PTBR: * Corrigidos valores de Z incorretos para itens colocados em móveis do tipo mesa redonda.

old.EN: * Fixed an issue where processing a split quantity of materials from a container with "Auto Sort" enabled would cause processing to begin for every stack.
old.PTBR: * Corrigido um problema em que processar uma quantidade dividida de materiais de um contêiner com "Auto-Ordenar" ativo fazia o processamento começar para cada pilha.

old.EN: * Fixed and adjusted several issues in One Block mode.
old.PTBR: * Corrigidos e ajustados vários problemas no modo Um Bloco.

old.EN: * Other minor fixes and adjustments.
old.PTBR: * Outras correções e ajustes menores.

old.EN: [Notes]
old.PTBR: [Notas]

old.EN: * For Performance, we are considering adding features such as learning songs based on skill level in the next Nightly update.
old.PTBR: * Sobre Desempenho, estamos considerando adicionar recursos como aprender canções conforme o nível de perícia na próxima atualização Nightly.

old.EN: * We also hope to debut Girlmatons on a regular basis.
old.PTBR: * Também esperamos estrear Garotamatons com regularidade.

old.EN: * Added settings related to Home time-progression simulation to the Experimental tab of the Settings window.
old.PTBR: * Adicionadas configurações relacionadas à simulação de progressão de tempo do Lar na aba Experimental da janela de Configurações.

old.EN: * Added the furniture "Great Door Frame." A recipe has also been added.
old.PTBR: * Adicionado o móvel "Moldura de Porta Grandiosa". Uma receita também foi adicionada.

old.EN: * When displaying targeting highlights for spells and similar effects, tiles containing walls, stairs, etc. will now highlight the floor.
old.PTBR: * Ao exibir destaques de mira para feitiços e efeitos similares, pisos com paredes, escadas etc. agora destacam o chão.
